## Overview

The IDSWG Randomization Working Group is a joint initiative with PSI/EFSPI and ASA-BIOP, co-chaired by **Johannes Krisam, Ph.D.** and **Kerstine Carter** (both Boehringer Ingelheim) and **Alex Sverdlov, Ph.D.** (Novartis).

The WG focuses on bringing awareness to modern randomization approaches that go beyond standard permuted-block methods, improving efficiency, balancing prognostic factors, and supporting the use of covariate-adaptive and response-adaptive designs.

**Named PSI Special Interest Group of the Year in June 2025.**

## Membership

Approximately 50 active and inactive members spanning pharmaceutical industry (19), academia (24), and other organizations (7), with representation across EU/UK and the USA.

## Activities

- Monthly member-only meetings
- Open learning sessions accessible to non-members
- Publications, slide sets, and educational resources
- Conference presentations at JSM, PSI annual meeting, and other venues

## Resources

Visit the [Randomization WG website](https://randomization-wg.org/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} for publications, upcoming events, and membership information.
